component.title: Activity timeline
component.purpose: What an agent has actually done recently — turns taken, turns refused, gates raised — so a grant can be judged against behaviour rather than against its description.

claims.statement: A refused turn appears in the timeline with the same weight as a completed one.
claims.rationale: Refusals are how an operator learns a grant is too narrow; hiding them hides the signal.
